description: Open (or add to) a mock futures position. Requires the trade:futures scope. Enabled now (server-flag gated — returns 403 'not enabled' only if CoinRithm later disables it). idempotencyKey is REQUIRED and must be unique per intent. leverage 1-20, marginMusd >= 10. Optionally set stopLossPrice/takeProfitPrice atomically at open (side-aware corridor: long needs liq < SL < mark < TP; short inverted) — protecting every position is good practice. Quote first and CONFIRM with the user. Paper trading only (virtual mUSD). Fills follow paper_execution_v1 with a disclosed execution cost; see executionModel in quote/trade results.

agentTrace.description: Optional private trace metadata stored in the caller's ledger.

decisionId.description: Agent decision id for quote/write attribution.

rationaleSummary.description: Optional concise rationale summary. Do not include chain-of-thought, secrets, or account identity.

strategyLabel.description: Short strategy label, self-reported by the caller.

coinId.description: Coin UCID to open futures for. Use resolve_symbol first.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique per intent; reuse replays the original result.

side.description: Futures direction: long benefits if price rises; short benefits if price falls.

stopLossPrice.description: Optional resting stop-loss set atomically at open (USD trigger; fired by the per-minute worker).

takeProfitPrice.description: Optional resting take-profit set atomically at open (USD trigger; fired by the per-minute worker).

name: open_futures_position
title: Open futures position
